name: awin-network-redirect-categorize
description: Awin host → categorise as network-redirect, short-circuit before referral scanning.
citation: SPEC §3.2 step 5 — network-redirect categorisation.

name: cj-anrdoezrs-network-redirect
description: CJ Affiliate primary cycling domain (anrdoezrs.net) categorises as network-redirect; the path-based publisher and ad IDs are not extracted, only the host triggers categorisation.
citation: SPEC §3.2 step 5 — host-based categorisation. Sample link pattern documented at https://intercom.geni.us/en/articles/4275228-how-to-add-your-cj-affiliate-ids.

name: cj-dotomi-subdomain-network-redirect
description: CJ Affiliate also cycles cj.dotomi.com (a dotted subdomain on dotomi.com); the manifest lists the exact host so canonicalisation matches it without subdomain stripping (SPEC §3.2 step 1).
citation: SPEC §3.2 step 1 — exact host matching (no subdomain reduction). Confirms cj.dotomi.com matches when listed verbatim in domains[].

name: skimlinks-redirectingat-categorize
description: go.redirectingat.com is one of two Skimlinks hostnames — both are categorised as network-redirect.
citation: Skimlinks documentation — go.redirectingat.com and go.skimresources.com both appear in user-facing affiliate URLs.

name: skimlinks-skimresources-categorize
description: go.skimresources.com (the other Skimlinks hostname) categorises as network-redirect.
citation: Skimlinks documentation — alternative network host.

name: impact-radius-pxf-io-categorize
description: Impact Radius pxf.io host categorises as network-redirect.
citation: Impact Radius documentation — pxf.io is the canonical short host.

name: network-redirect-short-circuits-creator-shaped-params
description: Network-redirect categorisation runs first; even if a `tag=` parameter is present on awin1.com, the URL is still categorised as network-redirect and no params are preserved.
citation: SPEC §3.2 step 5 — network-redirect short-circuits the algorithm.

name: www-awin-canonical
description: Leading www. is stripped before network-redirect host matching too.
citation: SPEC §3.2 step 1 — canonicalisation applies before BOTH direct-injection and network-redirect matching.

name: similar-host-not-awin-defer
description: A host that contains the substring 'awin1.com' but is a different domain MUST NOT match.
citation: Defense in depth: matching is on canonicalised host equality, not substring.

name: amazon-creator-first-with-other-tracking
description: Creator-first conflict survives unrelated tracking params (utm_source, fbclid). The validator only forms an opinion on the creator referral; other params are left for the implementer.
citation: SPEC §3.2 step 4 — params that are not creator referrals are out of scope for the validator.

name: amazon-es-locale-preserve
description: Amazon Associates is per-locale; the manifest lists amazon.es separately from amazon.com. A creator tag on amazon.es is preserved against the amazon-es program.
citation: Amazon Associates terms — each Amazon storefront has its own affiliate program enrolment.

name: anonym-to-categorize
description: anonym.to naked-query privacy proxy categorises as network-redirect.
citation: wrappers.json#anonymto — anonym.to is a privacy-proxy wrapper, treated as network-redirect for categorisation.

name: facebook-l-categorize
description: l.facebook.com outbound wrapper categorises as network-redirect; the apex facebook.com MUST NOT.
citation: wrappers.json#facebook-l — Facebook outbound link wrapper on the l. subdomain only.

name: facebook-lm-categorize
description: lm.facebook.com (mobile-web) categorises as network-redirect.
citation: wrappers.json#facebook-lm — mobile-web counterpart to facebook-l.

name: href-li-categorize
description: href.li naked-query privacy proxy categorises as network-redirect.
citation: wrappers.json#hrefli — naked-query privacy proxy.

name: instagram-l-categorize
description: l.instagram.com outbound wrapper categorises as network-redirect; apex instagram.com MUST NOT.
citation: wrappers.json#instagram-l — Instagram outbound on the l. subdomain only.

name: medium-link-categorize
description: link.medium.com short link categorises as network-redirect.
citation: wrappers.json#medium-link — Medium path-based short link.

name: rakuten-linkshare-categorize
description: click.linksynergy.com (Rakuten LinkShare) categorises as network-redirect.
citation: wrappers.json#rakuten — Rakuten Advertising deeplink endpoint.

name: reddit-out-categorize
description: out.reddit.com outbound wrapper categorises as network-redirect; the apex reddit.com MUST NOT.
citation: wrappers.json#reddit-out — Reddit outbound on the out. subdomain only.

name: shareasale-categorize
description: shareasale.com /r.cfm endpoint categorises as network-redirect.
citation: wrappers.json#shareasale — ShareASale redirect endpoint.

name: snap-exit-categorize
description: exit.sc (Snap Exit) categorises as network-redirect; separate hostname from snapchat.com.
citation: wrappers.json#snap-exit — Snap's exit-redirect host.

name: tco-categorize
description: t.co (Twitter) categorises as network-redirect; subdomains like api.t.co MUST NOT match.
citation: wrappers.json#tco — Twitter t.co URL shortener; exact host only.

name: tradetracker-categorize
description: tc.tradetracker.net click endpoint categorises as network-redirect.
citation: wrappers.json#tradetracker — TradeTracker EU affiliate network.

name: vk-away-categorize
description: away.vk.com outbound wrapper categorises as network-redirect; apex vk.com MUST NOT.
citation: wrappers.json#vk-away — VK outbound on the away. subdomain only.
